\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usetikzlibrary{patterns}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[ybar,bar width=12pt,width=10cm,height=6cm,
  xmin=.5,xmax=2.5,ymin=0,ymax=7,enlargelimits=false,xtick={1,2},
  legend pos=north west,legend columns=2]
  \addplot[draw=red,pattern=north east lines,pattern color=magenta,fill opacity=.5]
    coordinates {(1,3) (2,4)};
  \addplot[draw=orange,fill=yellow,pattern=north west lines]
    coordinates {(1,2) (2,1.5)};
  \addplot[draw=blue,pattern=grid,fill=green]
    coordinates {(1,4) (2,3)};
  \addplot[fill=red,pattern=none,draw=teal]
    coordinates {(1,2) (2,1)};
  \legend{Hatch,Black,Solid,Hollow}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
